privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Samudaaay
privacy.item1: Samudaaay is focused on community development and aims to unite community members and work for their benefit. Any usage of the app and matrimony data is strictly for verified community members. Users who have login access must not share their credentials or app data with any other person. In case of any breach of terms and conditions, Samudaaay reserves the right to block access for such users and take necessary action.
privacy.item2: We may use our users' email addresses for sending promotions, news, website updates, and trust event updates.
privacy.item3: If you want us to remove your data, we will do so on your request.
privacy.item4: Registrations on this app are allowed only for verified community members. To verify users, we collect identity proof and supporting document details. Access to the app and matrimony services may be provided only after successful identity verification.
privacy.item5: Any legal complaints related to Samudaaay will be handled under the applicable jurisdiction.
privacy.item6: We collect personal data such as Date of Birth, Aadhaar Card, Name, Address, and other biodata details exclusively for matrimony purposes. We encrypt necessary data such as Aadhaar Number using the best available encryption techniques. Our website also uses an SSL certificate that provides an extra layer of security while browsing the site.
